translations.EN: Say that again and see how far it gets you.
translations.TL: Sabihin mo ulit at tingnan natin kung saan ka aabot.

translations.EN: You want to push this? I will push back harder.
translations.TL: Gusto mong isagad ito? Mas malakas akong gaganti.

translations.EN: Don't make threats you can't survive.
translations.TL: Huwag kang magbanta ng hindi mo kayang maligtasan.

translations.EN: Try me. See what happens to you.
translations.TL: Subukan mo ako. Tingnan mo kung anong mangyayari sa 'yo.

translations.EN: You're digging your own grave with that talk.
translations.TL: Hinuhukay mo ang sarili mong libingan sa salitang 'yan.

translations.EN: Keep running that mouth and find out.
translations.TL: Sige, magpatuloy ka sa kadadaldal at nang malaman mo.

translations.EN: I'm not the one to mess with out here.
translations.TL: Hindi ako ang taong dapat mong ginagalit dito.

translations.EN: Push one more inch and we have bloodshed.
translations.TL: Sumulong ka pa nang isang pulgada at magkakadugo.

translations.EN: Say it one more time. I dare you.
translations.TL: Ulitin mo pa nang isang beses. Hinahamon kita.

translations.EN: You will regret crossing me.
translations.TL: Pagsisisihan mo ang pagbangga sa akin.

translations.EN: You're really testing me right now.
translations.TL: Talagang sinusubok mo ang pasensya ko ngayon.

translations.EN: Don't push your luck any further.
translations.TL: Huwag mo nang isugal pa ang suwerte mo.

translations.EN: You're out of line, and I won't stand for it.
translations.TL: Sumusobra ka na, at hindi ako papayag diyan.

translations.EN: You started this, but I'll finish it if I have to.
translations.TL: Ikaw ang nagsimula, pero tatapusin ko kung kailangan.

translations.EN: You're making a massive mistake talking to me like that.
translations.TL: Napakalaking pagkakamali ang kausapin ako nang ganyan.

translations.EN: Think very carefully about what you say next.
translations.TL: Pag-isipan mong mabuti ang susunod mong sasabihin.

translations.EN: I've had about enough of your disrespect.
translations.TL: Sapat na ang pambabastos mo sa akin.

translations.EN: You're crossing a boundary you can't walk back.
translations.TL: Tumatawid ka sa hangganang hindi mo na mababawi.

translations.EN: Back down before this escalates completely.
translations.TL: Umatras ka bago pa tuluyang magkagulo.

translations.EN: I'm answering in kind: knock it off.
translations.TL: Sasagutin kita nang patas: itigil mo na 'yan.

translations.EN: Keep talking.
translations.TL: Sige, magsalita ka pa.

translations.EN: Try it.
translations.TL: Subukan mo.

translations.EN: Dare you.
translations.TL: Hamon ko sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Push me.
translations.TL: Itulak mo ako.

translations.EN: Wrong move.
translations.TL: Maling hakbang.

translations.EN: Big mistake.
translations.TL: Malaking pagkakamali.

translations.EN: Last chance.
translations.TL: Huling pagkakataon.

translations.EN: Bring it.
translations.TL: Sige, ilabas mo.

translations.EN: Don't test me.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong subukan.

translations.EN: Watch yourself.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka.

translations.EN: You're pushing this too far.
translations.TL: Sobra na ang ginagawa mo.

translations.EN: I've been patient with you, but you're crossing the line.
translations.TL: Matiisin ako sa 'yo, pero lumalagpas ka na.

translations.EN: Don't make me treat you like a stranger.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong piliting tratuhin ka na parang estranghero.

translations.EN: I didn't think you would turn on me like this.
translations.TL: Di ko akalaing kakalabanin mo ako nang ganito.

translations.EN: You're hurting someone who actually cared about you.
translations.TL: Sinasaktan mo ang taong may tunay na malasakit sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Stop pushing me away with this cruelty.
translations.TL: Tigilan mo ang pagtataboy sa akin gamit ang lupit na 'yan.

translations.EN: If you keep attacking me, I will protect myself.
translations.TL: Kung patuloy mo akong aatakihin, ipagtatanggol ko ang sarili ko.

translations.EN: You're throwing our bond away right in front of me.
translations.TL: Itinatapon mo ang samahan natin mismo sa harap ko.

translations.EN: I expected better from you. Don't push me further.
translations.TL: Umasa ako ng mas maayos sa 'yo. Huwag mo na akong itulak.

translations.EN: Check yourself. I won't just stand here and take abuse.
translations.TL: Ayusin mo sarili mo. Di ako tatayo lang dito para magpaabuso.
